LENG.description: Member Unbraced Length (LENG). Keyed by element id (the element must already exist in the model); sets the unbraced lengths used by the AIJ-ASD02 steel member design check; all fields are optional overrides. Requires the AIJ-ASD02 steel design code to be activated first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. The AIJ-ASD02 handler exposes only LY, LZ, LB and bNOTUSE: LT and bAUTOCALC are neither read nor written by this code. DELETE removes the unbraced-length assignment from the element.

LY.description: Unbraced Length Ly (about the y-axis). 0 = use the member length.

LZ.description: Unbraced Length Lz (about the z-axis). 0 = use the member length.

LB.description: Laterally Unbraced Length. 0 = use the member length.

bNOTUSE.description: Do not consider the laterally unbraced length.

bAUTOCALC.description: Calculate the unbraced length automatically by code (ignored by this code: the AIJ-ASD02 handler neither stores nor returns it).

LT.description: Torsional Unbraced Length (ignored by this code: the AIJ-ASD02 handler neither stores nor returns it).
